purpose: Decision on whether the external KVarN 4/2-bit K/V scheme transfers to the Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S gfx1151 campaign.
external_premise: Huawei CSL KVarN: Hadamard + variance normalization + 4-bit keys / 2-bit values per 128-token tile, ~840 B/token/layer, calibration-free vLLM backend (arXiv 2606.03458, github.com/huawei-csl/KVarN); exists to fit ~262k context on a 24 GB card.

decision_per_backend.gfx1100_w7900: INT8 K/V already reaches the 256K model limit (admitted KL 1.04e-5/1.35e-4, 100% top-1, 126K verified, projects to model max-position ceiling) -> 4/2-bit adds zero capacity; model-bound, not memory-bound.
decision_per_backend.gfx1151_campaign: 128 GB unified memory; context is not the constraint. R1 re-closed native INT8 K/V on the Q4_K_S head (pure_int8 keeps 48 MiB BF16 mirror -> layout gate fails; tail4_hadamard mirror-free but top-1 0.889 < 0.90 floor). KVarN 4/2-bit is strictly lower precision than INT8 -> even harder gate, no capacity win.
decision_per_backend.xtx_out_of_scope: Only backend where INT8 126K -> ~200K extension has some pull; not part of this gfx1151 campaign.

decision: Do not implement or test KVarN in this campaign. If ever revisited, gate on the same KL/top-1 curve plus bytes-vs-quality versus our own INT8 (not the external's capacity headline), and only on a backend where context capacity is the binding constraint (XTX-style), never gfx1151.

evidence.gfx1100_int8_admission: campaign doc R1 reopen note: KL 1.04e-5/1.35e-4, 100% top-1, 126K context, W7900 reaches the 256K model limit
